greeting.text: Visitors, in this cold. I am a hermit, and I keep a staff that was left with me for the heir of the Lightbearer. I do not hand it to anyone who asks nicely. There is a thing I want, a harp of silver, and it is not in my cave.

trade.text: A harp of silver, with a voice like the moon. I have not heard that sound in sixty years. Take the staff, heir of the Lightbearer, and use it well.

effects.message: The hermit lays the harp on his knee and plucks one string. Then he reaches up and gives you the grey staff.

done.text: Go well. The rain has been a long time coming.

after.text: The staff is yours. Do not lose the second thing you were given.
